name: abilities-mcp
description: Connect AI clients to WordPress through the Abilities API. One-click bridge to your site's content, users, plugins, and Fluent ecosystem.
long_description:
Abilities MCP is the open-source bridge that turns any WordPress site into a first-class MCP server. Install this bundle, type your site URL + WordPress username + application password, and your AI client gets typed access to content, users, media, plugins, themes, settings, FluentCRM/Forms/Community, and any other ability registered through the WordPress Abilities API.

Requires the `abilities-mcp-adapter` and `abilities-for-ai` plugins on the WordPress site. The adapter exposes the MCP endpoint; this bundle is the client-side bridge running on your machine.

site_url.title: WordPress Site URL
site_url.description: Your WordPress site URL, e.g. https://example.com

username.title: WordPress Username
username.description: The WordPress username the AI will act as. Capabilities of this user determine what abilities are available.

app_password.title: Application Password
app_password.description: WordPress Application Password (Users → Profile → Application Passwords). Stored encrypted in your OS keychain.
